title: REQ · Clicking Retry reloads history and returns to the loading state
summary: Retry increments reload key, re-fetches and shows loading
description: Context: the Retry button increments reloadKey, which re-runs the history effect that sets historyStatus to 'loading' and calls listMine. Desired behavior: after the click the error is gone, the loading message shows while pending, and listMine is called again. Expected result: the player sees the loading state, then the list or a new error. Why: gives clear feedback that a retry is in progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given the error state, When Retry is clicked and listMine is pending, Then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown and the error alert and Retry button are absent
Given Retry is clicked, When the call settles, Then listMine has been called exactly twice
Given Retry fails again, When the second call rejects, Then the error and Retry are shown again

in_scope: Retry click handler and effect re-run
preserve: Cancellation guard in the history effect

technical_constraints: Reload driven by reloadKey in the effect dependencies
definition_of_done: Retry returns to loading and refetches
